Read in HU data and set up results dataframes
```{r}
# Read in expression matrix
expr <- read.csv("/Users/oaksgil/Desktop/Oaks-Do-HbF-Paper/Code to Upload/RNA-Seq/GO131_expression_matrix_all.csv")
# Extract counts
count_mat <- expr %>%
  select(gene_id, ends_with("_count")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")
# Ensure integer mode
count_mat <- round(as.matrix(count_mat))
# Remove suffix, e.g. X832Z3K_10_count -> X832Z3K_10
colnames(count_mat) <- sub("_count$", "", colnames(count_mat))
# Create sample names
sample_names <- c(
  "1_HUDEP-0hr",  "2_HUDEP-0hr",  "3_HUDEP-0hr",  "4_HUDEP-0hr",
  "5_HUDEP-1hr",  "6_HUDEP-1hr",  "7_HUDEP-1hr",
  "8_HUDEP-4hr",  "9_HUDEP-4hr",  "10_HUDEP-4hr",
  "11_HUDEP-24hr", "12_HUDEP-24hr", "13_HUDEP-24hr", "14_HUDEP-24hr",
  "15_K562-0hr",  "16_K562-0hr",  "17_K562-0hr",  "18_K562-0hr",
  "19_K562-1hr",  "20_K562-1hr",  "21_K562-1hr",  "22_K562-1hr",
  "23_K562-4hr",  "24_K562-4hr",  "25_K562-4hr",  "26_K562-4hr",
  "27_K562-24hr", "28_K562-24hr", "29_K562-24hr", "30_K562-24hr")
# Rename count matrix columns using sample IDs
col_ids <- as.integer(sub("^X832Z3K_", "", colnames(count_mat)))
colnames(count_mat) <- sample_names[col_ids]
# Create metadata from corrected sample names
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(count_mat),
  cell_line = ifelse(grepl("HUDEP", colnames(count_mat)), "HUDEP", "K562"),
  timepoint = sub(".*-", "", colnames(count_mat)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_info$timepoint <- factor(
  sample_info$timepoint,
  levels = c("0hr", "1hr", "4hr", "24hr"))

rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample

# Make DESeq object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat,
  colData   = sample_info,
  design    = ~ cell_line + timepoint)

###### HUDEP ######

dds_HUDEP <- dds[, dds$cell_line == "HUDEP"]
design(dds_HUDEP) <- ~ timepoint
dds_HUDEP <- DESeq(dds_HUDEP)


# Save as CSV
#write.csv(res_HUDEP_df,
          #"Downloads/HUDEP_differential_expression.csv",
          #row.names = TRUE)

HUDEP_res_1hr <- results(dds_HUDEP, contrast = c("timepoint", "1hr", "0hr"))
HUDEP_res_4hr <- results(dds_HUDEP, contrast = c("timepoint", "4hr", "0hr"))
HUDEP_res_24hr <- results(dds_HUDEP, contrast = c("timepoint", "24hr", "0hr"))

all_HUDEP_df <- bind_rows(
  as.data.frame(HUDEP_res_1hr) %>% mutate(timepoint = "1hr", cell_line = "HUDEP"),
  as.data.frame(HUDEP_res_4hr) %>% mutate(timepoint = "4hr", cell_line = "HUDEP"),
  as.data.frame(HUDEP_res_24hr) %>% mutate(timepoint = "24hr", cell_line = "HUDEP")
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id")

# Clean ENSEMBL IDs
all_HUDEP_df$gene_id_clean <- sub("\\.\\.\\..*$", "", all_HUDEP_df$gene_id)
# Map ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbols
all_HUDEP_df$gene_name <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = all_HUDEP_df$gene_id_clean,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first")

# Split results by cell line and timepoint
HUDEP_res_1hr_df <- filter(all_HUDEP_df, timepoint == "1hr")
HUDEP_res_4hr_df <- filter(all_HUDEP_df, timepoint == "4hr")
HUDEP_res_24hr_df <- filter(all_HUDEP_df, timepoint == "24hr")
```

Read in UNC-0646 and dWIZ-2 data and set up results dataframes
```{r}
expr_uncdwiz = read.csv("/Users/oaksgil/Desktop/Oaks-Do-HbF-Paper/Code to Upload/RNA-seq/GO135_expressionmat_all.csv")

count_mat_uncdwiz <- expr_uncdwiz %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, ends_with("_count")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

# Ensure integer mode
count_mat_uncdwiz <- round(as.matrix(count_mat_uncdwiz))
colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz)
colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz) <- sub("_count$", "", colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz))

sample_names <- c("1_unt","2_unt","3_unt","4_unc","5_unc","6_unc","7_dwiz","8_dwiz","9_dwiz")

col_ids <- as.integer(sub("^S47Z2W_", "", colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz)))

colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz) <- sample_names[col_ids]

sample_info_uncdwiz <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz),
  cell_line = "HUDEP",
   treatment = sub(".*_", "", colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

rownames(sample_info_uncdwiz) <- sample_info_uncdwiz$sample

dds_uncdwiz <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat_uncdwiz,
  colData   = sample_info_uncdwiz,
  design    = ~ treatment)

# remove outlier BEFORE DESeq
dds_uncdwiz <- dds_uncdwiz[, colnames(dds_uncdwiz) != "3_unt"]

# reset droplevels
dds_uncdwiz$treatment <- droplevels(factor(dds_uncdwiz$treatment))
dds_uncdwiz$treatment <- relevel(dds_uncdwiz$treatment, ref = "unt")

# now run DESeq
dds_uncdwiz <- DESeq(dds_uncdwiz)

res_unc <- results(
  dds_uncdwiz,
  contrast = c("treatment", "unc", "unt")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  rename(
    log2FC_unc_vs_unt = log2FoldChange,
    pval_unc_vs_unt = pvalue,
    padj_unc_vs_unt = padj)

res_dwiz <- results(
  dds_uncdwiz,
  contrast = c("treatment", "dwiz", "unt")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  rename(
    log2FC_dwiz_vs_unt = log2FoldChange,
    pval_dwiz_vs_unt = pvalue,
    padj_dwiz_vs_unt = padj)

res_combined_uncdwiz <- res_unc %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, log2FC_unc_vs_unt, pval_unc_vs_unt, padj_unc_vs_unt, baseMean) %>%
  left_join(
    res_dwiz %>%
      dplyr::select(gene_id, log2FC_dwiz_vs_unt, pval_dwiz_vs_unt, padj_dwiz_vs_unt, baseMean),
    by = "gene_id")

res_combined_uncdwiz$SYMBOL <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = res_combined_uncdwiz$gene_id,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first")
```

Make QC Plots for HU RNA-seq
```{r}
###################### HU ######################
rv <- rowVars(counts(dds_HUDEP))
top1000 <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[1:1000]
dds_top <- dds_HUDEP[top1000, ]

###### PCA 
# Make VST
vsd <- vst(dds_top, blind = FALSE)
# Extract PCA data
pcaData <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("timepoint"), returnData = TRUE)
#calculate the percent variance
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))
# Make the PCA plot in ggplot2
ggplot(pcaData, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                         color = timepoint)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15)) +
    labs(
        x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
        y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

###### Sample Distance Matrix 
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(vsd)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- vsd$treatment
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- vsd$treatment
#make heatmap of all samples
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols = sampleDists,
         color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9,"Blues")))(255),
         main="Sample Distance Heatmap")

###### Library sizes 
library_sizes <- colSums(counts(dds_HUDEP))
barplot(library_sizes,
        las=2,
        main="Library Size per Sample",
        ylab="Total Counts",
        col="grey") 


###################### UNC-0646 and dWIZ-2 ######################
```

```{r}
  df %>%
    filter(
      abs(Distance.to.TSS) < 5000 )})


# Combine both lists
homer_list_tssfilt <- c(tss_filtered_homer_list, g9a_wiz_filtered_homer)

  unique(df$Gene.Name)})

homer_list_tssfilt_genesets <- lapply(homer_list_tssfilt_genesets, function(gs) {
  gs %>%
    na.omit() %>%            # remove NA
    str_trim() %>%           # remove whitespace
    .[. != ""] %>%           # remove empty strings
    unique()})

max_len <- max(sapply(homer_list_tssfilt_genesets, length))

padded <- lapply(homer_list_tssfilt_genesets, function(x) {
  length(x) <- max_len
  x
})

df <- as.data.frame(padded)
```

Figure 1C:
```{r}
# ============================================================
# DESEQ2 LOG2FC BARPLOTS WITH:
#   - DESeq2 log2FC bars
#   - DESeq2 lfcSE error bars
#   - DESeq2 adjusted-p-value significance
#   - Individual biological replicate points
# ============================================================

library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(scales)


# ============================================================
# 1. FUNCTION TO RUN DESEQ2
# ============================================================

get_logFC_padj_long <- function(count_mat,
                                sample_info,
                                timepoints = c("0hr", "1hr", "4hr", "24hr"),
                                min_count = 10,
                                min_samples = 2) {
  
  sample_info$timepoint <- factor(
    sample_info$timepoint,
    levels = timepoints
  )
  
  cell_lines <- unique(sample_info$cell_line)
  
  long_list <- list()
  dds_list  <- list()
  
  
  for (cl in cell_lines) {
    
    message("Running DESeq for: ", cl)
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Subset samples
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    idx <- sample_info$cell_line == cl
    
    count_sub <- count_mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]
    info_sub  <- sample_info[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Filter low-count genes
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    keep <- rowSums(count_sub >= min_count) >= min_samples
    
    count_sub <- count_sub[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
    message(
      "Genes retained after filtering: ",
      nrow(count_sub)
    )
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DESeq2
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = count_sub,
      colData   = info_sub,
      design    = ~ timepoint
    )
    
    dds <- DESeq(
      dds,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
    
    
    # Save DDS object so we can get normalized counts later
    dds_list[[cl]] <- dds
    
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract contrasts vs 0 hr
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    
    for (tp in timepoints[timepoints != "0hr"]) {
      
      res <- results(
        dds,
        contrast = c(
          "timepoint",
          tp,
          "0hr"
        )
      )
      
      
      df <- data.frame(
        gene      = rownames(res),
        cell_line = cl,
        timepoint = tp,
        log2FC    = res$log2FoldChange,
        lfcSE     = res$lfcSE,
        pvalue    = res$pvalue,
        padj      = res$padj,
        baseMean  = res$baseMean,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      
      long_list[[paste(
        cl,
        tp,
        sep = "_"
      )]] <- df
    }
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine DESeq2 results
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  long_df <- bind_rows(long_list)
  
  
  # Clean Ensembl IDs
  long_df$gene_clean <- sub(
    "\\..*$",
    "",
    long_df$gene
  )
  
  
  # Map to gene symbols
  gene_map <- mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = long_df$gene_clean,
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
  
  long_df$gene_symbol <- gene_map
  
  
  long_df <- long_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene_symbol,
      gene,
      cell_line,
      timepoint,
      log2FC,
      lfcSE,
      pvalue,
      padj,
      baseMean
    )
  
  
  # Return both results and DDS objects
  return(
    list(
      results = long_df,
      dds = dds_list
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 2. RUN DESEQ2
# ============================================================

deseq_out <- get_logFC_padj_long(
  count_mat,
  sample_info
)


# DESeq2 results
long_logFC <- deseq_out$results


# HUDEP DESeqDataSet
dds_HUDEP <- deseq_out$dds[["HUDEP"]]


# ============================================================
# 3. SELECT GENES OF INTEREST
# ============================================================

genes_interest <- c(
  "HBG1",
  "HBG2",
  "HBB"
)


df_interest <- long_logFC %>%
  
  filter(
    gene_symbol %in% genes_interest,
    baseMean > 5,
    cell_line == "HUDEP",
    timepoint %in% c(
      "1hr",
      "4hr",
      "24hr"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    gene_symbol = factor(
      gene_symbol,
      levels = genes_interest
    ),
    
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c(
        "1hr",
        "4hr",
        "24hr"
      )
    ),
    
    
    # DESeq2 error bars
    ymin = log2FC - lfcSE,
    ymax = log2FC + lfcSE,
    
    
    # Significance
    sig = case_when(
      padj < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      padj < 0.001  ~ "***",
      padj < 0.01   ~ "**",
      padj < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ ""
    ),
    
    
    # Position significance above error bars
    star_y = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      ymax + 0.12,
      ymin - 0.12
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. GET NORMALIZED COUNTS FOR INDIVIDUAL REPLICATES
# ============================================================

norm_counts <- counts(
  dds_HUDEP,
  normalized = TRUE
)


# Convert to dataframe
norm_df <- as.data.frame(norm_counts)

norm_df$gene <- rownames(norm_df)


# Clean Ensembl IDs
norm_df$gene_clean <- sub(
  "\\..*$",
  "",
  norm_df$gene
)


# Convert Ensembl -> gene symbol
gene_map <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = norm_df$gene_clean,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

norm_df$gene_symbol <- gene_map


# ============================================================
# 5. CONVERT NORMALIZED COUNTS TO LONG FORMAT
# ============================================================

replicate_df <- norm_df %>%
  
  filter(
    gene_symbol %in% genes_interest
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol,
    all_of(colnames(norm_counts))
  ) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_symbol,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "normalized_count"
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. ADD SAMPLE METADATA
# ============================================================

sample_metadata <- as.data.frame(
  colData(dds_HUDEP)
)

sample_metadata$sample <- rownames(
  sample_metadata
)


replicate_df <- replicate_df %>%
  
  left_join(
    sample_metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample,
        timepoint
      ),
    by = "sample"
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. CALCULATE REPLICATE-LEVEL LOG2 FOLD CHANGE
#
# Each replicate is expressed relative to the mean normalized
# expression of the 0 hr biological replicates.
#
# A pseudocount of 1 avoids log2(0).
# ============================================================

baseline_df <- replicate_df %>%
  
  filter(
    timepoint == "0hr"
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(
    gene_symbol
  ) %>%
  
  summarise(
    baseline_mean = mean(
      normalized_count
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


replicate_df <- replicate_df %>%
  
  left_join(
    baseline_df,
    by = "gene_symbol"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    replicate_log2FC = log2(
      (normalized_count + 1) /
      (baseline_mean + 1)
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. KEEP ONLY TREATED TIMEPOINTS
# ============================================================

replicate_df <- replicate_df %>%
  
  filter(
    timepoint %in% c(
      "1hr",
      "4hr",
      "24hr"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    gene_symbol = factor(
      gene_symbol,
      levels = genes_interest
    ),
    
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c(
        "1hr",
        "4hr",
        "24hr"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. MAKE PLOT
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  df_interest,
  aes(
    x = timepoint,
    y = log2FC,
    fill = log2FC
  )
) +
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2 log2FC bars
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2 standard error
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax
    ),
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Individual biological replicates
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  geom_point(
    data = replicate_df,
    aes(
      x = timepoint,
      y = replicate_log2FC
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      height = 0
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.8,
    stroke = 0.7,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2 significance
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = star_y,
      label = sig
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # One panel per gene
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~gene_symbol,
    scales = "fixed"
  ) +
  
  
  # Zero line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Color scale
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1.5, 1.5),
    oob = squish,
    name = expression(
```

```{r}
prep_motif_df <- function(df, n_show = 8) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Adjusted.P.value = as.numeric(Adjusted.P.value),
      P.value = as.numeric(P.value),
      neg_log10_p = -log10(P.value),
      sig = P.value < 0.05
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(neg_log10_p)) %>%
    arrange(P.value) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_show) %>%
    mutate(
      Term = str_replace_all(Term, "_", " "),
      Term = str_wrap(Term, width = 28))
}

    neg_log10_p = max(neg_log10_p),
    .groups = "drop")

    neg_log10_p = max(neg_log10_p),

xmax <- max(c(k9me2_down_atac_CHEA$neg_log10_p, k9me2_down_atac_ENCODE$neg_log10_p), na.rm = TRUE)

make_plot <- function(df, title, color) {
  cutoff <- -log10(0.05)
  #df <- df %>%
    #mutate(Term_clean = sub(" .*", "", Term))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = neg_log10_p, y = reorder(Term_clean, neg_log10_p))) +
    geom_col(fill = color, width = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, xmax * 1.05), expand = c(0,0)) +
    labs(
      x = expression(-log[10]("p-value")),
      y = NULL,
      title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)
}
```

Figure S6C
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMBINE HU 24HR + UNC/dWIZ FOR BATCH-CORRECTED PCA
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. GO131: keep HUDEP untreated + HU 24hr only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

hu_keep <- sample_info$cell_line == "HUDEP" &
  sample_info$timepoint %in% c("0hr", "24hr")

hu_counts <- count_mat[, hu_keep]

hu_meta <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(hu_counts),
  condition = case_when(
    grepl("-0hr$",  colnames(hu_counts)) ~ "Untreated",
    grepl("-24hr$", colnames(hu_counts)) ~ "HU 24hr"
  ),
  experiment = "GO131",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rownames(hu_meta) <- hu_meta$sample


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. GO135: untreated + UNC + dWIZ
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Remove the untreated outlier
unc_counts <- count_mat_uncdwiz[
  ,
  colnames(count_mat_uncdwiz) != "3_unt"
]

unc_meta <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(unc_counts),
  condition = case_when(
    grepl("_unt$",  colnames(unc_counts)) ~ "Untreated",
    grepl("_unc$",  colnames(unc_counts)) ~ "UNC",
    grepl("_dwiz$", colnames(unc_counts)) ~ "dWIZ"
  ),
  experiment = "GO135",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rownames(unc_meta) <- unc_meta$sample


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Keep genes present in both experiments
# ------------------------------------------------------------

common_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(hu_counts),
  rownames(unc_counts)
)

hu_counts <- hu_counts[
  common_genes,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

unc_counts <- unc_counts[
  common_genes,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine count matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_counts <- cbind(
  hu_counts,
  unc_counts
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combine metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_meta <- bind_rows(
  hu_meta,
  unc_meta
)

rownames(combined_meta) <- combined_meta$sample

# Ensure exact same ordering as count matrix
combined_meta <- combined_meta[
  colnames(combined_counts),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Check sample assignments
# ------------------------------------------------------------

table(
  combined_meta$condition,
  combined_meta$experiment
)

combined_meta[, c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "experiment"
)]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Set factor levels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined_meta$condition <- factor(
  combined_meta$condition,
  levels = c(
    "Untreated",
    "HU 24hr",
    "UNC",
    "dWIZ"
  )
)

combined_meta$experiment <- factor(
  combined_meta$experiment
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Create DESeq2 object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dds_combined <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(combined_counts),
  colData = combined_meta,
  design = ~ experiment + condition
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Filter low-count genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

keep <- rowSums(
  counts(dds_combined) >= 10
) >= 2

dds_combined <- dds_combined[keep, ]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Variance-stabilizing transformation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

vsd_combined <- vst(
  dds_combined,
  blind = TRUE
)

vst_mat <- assay(vsd_combined)


# ============================================================
# BATCH CORRECTION
# ============================================================

# Tell limma which biological differences to preserve
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ condition,
  data = combined_meta
)

# Check design is full rank
qr(design)$rank
ncol(design)

# Remove GO131 vs GO135 batch effect
batch_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(
  vst_mat,
  batch = combined_meta$experiment,
  design = design
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Find top 1000 variable genes after correction
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rv <- rowVars(batch_corrected)

top1000 <- order(
  rv,
  decreasing = TRUE
)[seq_len(min(1000, length(rv)))]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. PCA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pca_corrected <- prcomp(
  t(batch_corrected[top1000, ]),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

percentVar <- round(
  100 *
    pca_corrected$sdev^2 /
    sum(pca_corrected$sdev^2),
  1
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. PCA dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pcaData <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_corrected$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_corrected$x[, 2],
  combined_meta
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p <- ggplot(
  pcaData,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    color = condition,
    shape = experiment
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0(
      "PC1: ",
      percentVar[1],
      "% variance"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PC2: ",
      percentVar[2],
      "% variance"
    ),
    color = "Treatment",
    shape = "Experiment"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p

# Extract PC2 loading

pc2_loadings <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(pca_corrected$rotation),
  loading = pca_corrected$rotation[, "PC2"]
) %>%
  mutate(abs_loading = abs(loading)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_loading))

# Convert Ensembl IDs to gene symbols
pc2_loadings$gene_name <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = pc2_loadings$gene,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

pc2_loadings <- pc2_loadings %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_name))

top_pc2 <- pc2_loadings %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  arrange(loading)

ggplot(
  top_pc2,
  aes(
    x = reorder(gene_name, loading),
    y = loading
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "PC2 loading",
    title = "Genes contributing most strongly to PC2"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

pc2_loadings <- pc2_loadings %>%
  mutate(G9a_WIZ_target = gene_name %in% homer_list_tssfilt_genesets$`250809_k9me2_all_atac_annotation`
         )

ggplot(
  pc2_loadings,
  aes(
    x = G9a_WIZ_target,
    y = loading
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "G9a/WIZ occupied",
    y = "PC2 loading"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

wilcox.test(
  loading ~ G9a_WIZ_target,
  data = pc2_loadings
)
```

```{r}
# Build contingency table
fisher_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    overlap,   hu_only,
    g9a_only,  neither
  ),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(
    HU = c("Up", "Not up"),
    G9a = c("Up", "Not up")
  )
)

fisher_result <- fisher.test(
  fisher_matrix,
  alternative = "greater"
)

fisher_result

HU_total <- overlap + hu_only
G9a_total <- overlap + g9a_only

expected_overlap <- HU_total * G9a_total / N

fold_enrichment <- overlap / expected_overlap
```

Figure S7A:
```{r}
get_logFC_padj_long <- function(count_mat,
                                sample_info,
                                timepoints = c("0hr","1hr","4hr","24hr"),
                                min_count = 10,
                                min_samples = 2) {
  
  # Ensure proper ordering
  sample_info$timepoint <- factor(sample_info$timepoint,levels = timepoints)
  
  cell_lines <- unique(sample_info$cell_line)
  
  long_list <- list()
  
  for(cl in cell_lines) {
    
    message("Running DESeq for: ", cl)
    
    # Subset samples
    idx <- sample_info$cell_line == cl
    count_sub <- count_mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]
    info_sub  <- sample_info[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # ------------------------------
    # Pre-filter low-count genes
    # ------------------------------
    keep <- rowSums(count_sub >= min_count) >= min_samples
    count_sub <- count_sub[keep, ]
    
    message("Genes retained after filtering: ", nrow(count_sub))
    
    # ------------------------------
    # DESeq2 analysis
    # ------------------------------
    dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = count_sub,
      colData   = info_sub,
      design    = ~ timepoint
    )
    
    dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
    
    # ------------------------------
    # Extract contrasts vs 0hr
    # ------------------------------
    for(tp in timepoints[timepoints != "0hr"]) {
      
      res <- results(dds,
                     contrast = c("timepoint", tp, "0hr"))
      
      df <- data.frame(
        gene      = rownames(res),
        cell_line = cl,
        timepoint = tp,
        log2FC    = res$log2FoldChange,
        padj      = res$padj,
        baseMean  = res$baseMean,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      long_list[[paste(cl, tp, sep = "_")]] <- df
      }
  }
  
  # ------------------------------
  # Combine all results
  # ------------------------------
  long_df <- bind_rows(long_list)
  
  # ------------------------------
  # Clean Ensembl IDs
  # ------------------------------
  long_df$gene_clean <- sub("\\..*$", "", long_df$gene)
  
  gene_map <- mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = long_df$gene_clean,
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    multiVals = "first")
  
  long_df$gene_symbol <- gene_map
  
  # Remove NA symbols
  long_df <- long_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_symbol))
  
  # Reorder columns nicely
  long_df <- long_df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, gene, cell_line,
                  timepoint, log2FC, padj, baseMean)
  
  return(long_df)
}

##

long_logFC <- get_logFC_padj_long(count_mat, sample_info)

long_logFC$timepoint <- factor(long_logFC$timepoint, levels = c("1hr", "4hr", "24hr"))

df_interest <- filter(
  long_logFC,
  gene_symbol %in% c("EHMT1", "EHMT2", "WIZ", "ZNF644", "BCL11A") &
    baseMean > 5 &
    cell_line == "HUDEP" &
    timepoint %in% c("1hr", "4hr", "24hr")
)

# keep gene order the way you want
df_interest$gene_symbol <- factor(
  df_interest$gene_symbol,
  levels = c("EHMT1", "EHMT2", "WIZ", "ZNF644", "BCL11A")
)

# y position for significance stars
df_interest <- df_interest %>%
  mutate(
    star_y = ifelse(log2FC >= 0, log2FC + 0.08, log2FC - 0.08),
    vjust_star = ifelse(log2FC >= 0, 0, 1)
  )
  
 p = ggplot(df_interest, aes(x = timepoint, y = log2FC, fill = log2FC)) +
  
  # Bars
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  
  # Significance stars for padj < 0.00001
  geom_text(
    data = subset(df_interest, padj < 0.00001),
    aes(x = timepoint, y = star_y, label = "*"),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # one panel per gene
  facet_wrap(~gene_symbol, scales = "fixed") +
  
  # zero line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Fixed color scale from -1.5 to 1.5
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1.5, 1.5),
    oob = squish,
    name = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change")
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Time after treatment",
    y = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change")
  ) + ylim(-1, 1) +
  # Theme
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )
```
